title: A robot powered by a brand new AI chip walked on stage
title_candidates: Qualcomm put their newest AI chip inside a robot for a live demo
A robot powered by a brand new AI chip walked on stage
They built a new AI chip and put it inside a robot to prove it works
This robot's brain was running on Qualcomm's newest AI chip
The moment a brand new AI robot was tested live on stage
caption:
A robot running Qualcomm's newest AI chip shut down in the middle of a live stage demo. The chip is built to run AI directly on the device instead of sending data to the cloud, and it's meant for robots, phones, and cars.

The whole crowd watched it freeze up and power off. Even the biggest tech companies can't control what happens live on stage.
